system.description:
Each successful Strike an enemy lands on you in a Brawl unlocks an effect that lasts while you stay in that Brawl. 1st hit: Escape with an Interact Action and no enemy gets an Attack Action against you. 2nd hit: +1 Attack Action on your Combat Turn. 3rd hit: Steeled until the Combat Encounter ends or that enemy is slain.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.48

when.label: A Brawling enemy has hit you twice and you're still in that Brawl

automation.note: Count each Brawling enemy's hits on you. 1st: Escape with an Interact Action and no enemy gets a free Attack Action. 2nd: the extra Attack Action is in your allowance; only take it while this applies. 3rd: Use this ability and click the Steeled button (lasts until combat ends); remove Steeled if that enemy is slain first.
